`final class AssetLocator`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.asset.locator` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [AssetLocator.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/asset/locator/AssetLocator.java)

The registry of the asset locators, which turns any input into an `Asset`.

## Description

JOID registers three locators, for a `File`, a `String` and an `InputStream`; register your own to accept another kind of input, such as an id of your application.
The last registered locator is asked first.

<a id="AssetLocator-method-locate"></a>

### locate

`Asset locate(Object handle)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: No asset locator knows the input … of type …, register an IAssetLocator that supports it with AssetLocator.register(...)

Returns `handle` when it is an asset, otherwise the asset of the first locator that supports it.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when no locator supports it.
